note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1967: ten contests, polled 1 June 1967 (Michael O'Neill withdrew in Newtownhamilton: Newry Reporter, 18 May 1967, p. 1). The other 19 divisions were returned unopposed (Newry Reporter, 18 May 1967, p. 1). Returned unopposed. Outgoing member (marked * in the list).
